RESULT [labelnoise]: The 10 test sets average at least 3.3% label errors, and at least 6% of the ImageNet validation set is mislabeled. ResNet-18 overtakes ResNet-50 if mislabeled test examples rise by just 6%. About 51% of CL-flagged candidates were confirmed by humans.
US [labelnoise]: The sealed cwd12 holdout is the rollback judge, so errors inside it can reverse 'better vs worse' decisions between increments. Audit the holdout labels (not only its leakage) before any automated accept or rollback rule depends on small mAP differences.
